name: An Alarming Request
label: Quest
description: Emissary Jacques in Southshore brings bad news out of Dalaran: the city's ley lines have been thrown off, and its constructs have turned erratic and…
intro: Emissary Jacques in Southshore brings bad news out of Dalaran: the city's ley lines have been thrown off, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. Archmage Modera sent Jacques to find outside aid, and you are told to seek her image near Dalaran, beside Lordamere Lake.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!
Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see Jacques was successful in garnering aid.
While not strictly permitted, we cannot allow our pride to turn away allies in our desperate hour. Do not let the guards fool you. Things are anything but under control.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
